context_items.title: Order Idempotency Key Caching Policy
context_items.rationale: To prevent duplicate order placements and double billing from network retries, clients provide an optional idempotency_key. If an order with that key already completed within the 10-minute cache window, the service immediately returns the cached completed Order without executing any stock reservation or payment processing again.

context_items.content: Every order state transition must append an AuditLogEntry to order.audit_log with from_status, to_status, and message. When a retry succeeds after transient failures, an audit log entry with to_status='RETRIED' must be recorded before final completion.

When reserving inventory in OrderService, lock contention raises InventoryUnavailableError with is_transient=True. The service must automatically retry transient lock errors with exponential backoff (initial_delay=0.1s, backoff_factor=2.0, max_retries=3). Permanent stock exhaustion has is_transient=False and must not be retried.
